senses.gloss:
__1 An imitative sound, as of a metallic jar rolling down steps; रामाभिषेके मदविह्वलायाः कक्षाच्च्युतो हेमघटस्तरुण्याः । सोपानमार्गे प्रकरोति शब्दं ठठं ठठं ठं ठठठं ठठं ठः [[Subhāṣ.]] 
__2 A loud noise. 
__3 The disc of the sun or moon. 
__4 A circle, globe. 
__5 A cypher. 
__6 A place resorted to or held sacred by all. 
__7 An object of sense. 
__8 An idol, deity. 
__9 An epithet of Śiva.
